blurb: Warren Golf Course is a collegiate golf course opened in 1999, hosting various championships. Guests can play 18-hole rounds with different rates for students, faculty, alumni, and the public. Practice facilities include a driving range, chipping green, and putting green.
extraNote: Annual pass holder rates available by inquiry at clubhouse or phone · Golf Professional and staff enforce dress code · Main entrance to the golf course on Douglas Road, approximately 1/4 mile east of the last roundabout.
